standard_prerequisites.name: Composition after a separated morphism

core_obligations: Work locally on the base: over any affine U of S the relative Proj is isomorphic to Proj(A) with A the sections of the algebra sheaf over U.
Proj(A) is separated by the absolute card, and Proj(A) to U is separated by composition; hence pi is separated.
proof_roadmap: Localize, identify the piece over an affine as Proj of the sections, apply the absolute card, and compose.
difficulty_reason: Localize on the base, identify the piece over an affine as Proj of the sections, apply the absolute separatedness card and compose; fully displayed.
